$comment: Maps component slugs to design-tool sources for traceability. shadcn/ui has no official Figma kit, so this starts empty. $ux-spec-extraction reads it to resolve a Figma file key and node ID for each component; while it is empty, that skill records design sources by URL or description instead, and the automated $ux-design path is unaffected. Populate a slug only when a real, maintained design source exists.
